description: Manifest extraConstraint (h) flags 'group_j dispatcher when MOTHER queue path is read-only' as an edge case to scrutinize. lib/group_j.py:227-237 _append_mother_queue calls queue_path.open('a') with no exception handling. PermissionError on a read-only filesystem would propagate uncaught into dispatch_self_recover, breaking the recovery dispatcher itself — the exact failure-recovery surface that is supposed to be most resilient. No test injects a read-only queue path. Similar: _append_log line 222-223 also has no exception handling. EDGE-10 in the spec calls out disk-full mid-write should leave the row recoverable; the impl has no recovery branch.

evidence.snippet: queue_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); with queue_path.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(...) — no try/except for PermissionError / OSError; would propagate uncaught.
